structures.name: Outer Guard Tower
structures.description: The first tower on each Human lane. Cheapest to break and the one that opens the lane.
structures.notes: Its own team cannot damage it above 50% health — denying only works once it is already half down.

structures.name: Middle Guard Tower
structures.description: The second tower on each Human lane. Same reach as the outer one, with more health and damage behind it.
structures.notes: Its own team cannot damage it above 50% health — denying only works once it is already half down.

structures.name: Inner Arcane Tower
structures.description: The last tower before the Castle. Hits harder than the lane towers but has to be walked into — its range is 200 shorter.

abilities.name: Feedback
abilities.description: Every attack destroys 24 mana — 14 against a hero — and deals bonus damage equal to the mana destroyed. Deals 20 extra damage to summoned units.

structures.notes: Its own team cannot damage it above 50% health — denying only works once it is already half down.

structures.name: Side Guard Tower
structures.description: Stands at the corners of the Human base and cannot be attacked. Anything it reaches dies to one hit.
structures.notes: Four per team, two above the top lane and two below the bottom one, flanking the base. It carries no health or armor figure here because nothing can bring it down.

structures.name: Castle
structures.description: The Human base. Destroy it and the Undead team wins the game.
structures.notes: Its own team cannot damage it above 50% health — denying only works once it is already half down.

structures.name: Fountain
structures.description: Stands behind the Human base among the shops. Refills health and mana of anything standing near it, and shoots back at whatever comes close.

abilities.name: Healing Ward (Fountain)
abilities.description: Restores 3.5% of maximum hit points per second to units within 500 range.

abilities.name: Fountain of Mana
abilities.description: Restores 3.5% of maximum mana per second to units within 500 range.

structures.notes: Both teams field the same building. Its attack carries no cooldown of its own — the map switched the attack on and left the field at zero — so it fires as fast as the animation allows and no damage per second can be given.

structures.name: Outer Spirit Tower
structures.description: The first tower on each Undead lane. Cheapest to break and the one that opens the lane.
structures.notes: Its own team cannot damage it above 50% health — denying only works once it is already half down.

structures.name: Middle Spirit Tower

structures.name: Inner Nerubian Tower
structures.description: The last tower before the Black Citadel. Its attack freezes whatever it hits, so walking off it costs more than the damage alone.

abilities.name: Frost Attack
abilities.description: Attacks slow movement speed by 50% and attack speed by 25% for 5 seconds.

structures.notes: Its own team cannot damage it above 50% health — denying only works once it is already half down.

structures.description: The Undead base. Destroy it and the Human team wins the game. Unlike the Castle, its attack also freezes.
